Backend Developer.summary: Backend developers build the part of an application users never see: servers, APIs and databases.
employers_expect: A backend language (often Python, Java or Node.js) with solid fundamentals
SQL and the ability to design simple tables
Building and using REST APIs
Git and teamwork basics
Awareness of cloud, containers and how systems scale
interview_focus: Explaining a project you built and why you designed it that way
Debugging a short piece of code
Backend Developer.note: The postings we read asked for 2 to 9 years of experience. For freshers, employers mostly test fundamentals, DSA and one real project, so the levels here are set lower than those postings. Curated by the project author from general industry knowledge and the job postings collected for this project. It is a guide, not an official standard. Review it with a mentor.

Data Analyst.summary: Data analysts clean data, find patterns and explain what they mean so teams can decide.
employers_expect: Strong spreadsheet skills (pivot tables, lookups, charts)
Basic SQL for pulling data
Turning messy data into clear insights
Charts and dashboards (Power BI or Tableau is a plus)
Curiosity, clear writing and communication
interview_focus: Excel tasks such as pivot tables and lookups
A small case study: what would you check first?
Explaining a chart in plain words
Data Analyst.note: In the postings we read, SQL and Python were often listed as basic or optional for fresher roles, while spreadsheets and insight skills were required. Curated by the project author from general industry knowledge and the job postings collected for this project. It is a guide, not an official standard. Review it with a mentor.

QA / Software Tester.summary: Testers make sure software works before users see it, by designing tests and reporting defects.
employers_expect: Writing and running test cases
Clear bug reports
Debugging and test reporting
Understanding of the software and testing life cycles
Basic SQL and API testing are a plus
interview_focus: Write test cases for a login page
QA / Software Tester.note: Based on one posting, so this role is provisional. Curated by the project author from general industry knowledge and the job postings collected for this project. It is a guide, not an official standard. Review it with a mentor.

Software Engineer.summary: Software engineers design, build and maintain applications, working in teams with reviews and tests.
employers_expect: Programming fundamentals in at least one language
Data structures and algorithms
Object-oriented programming
Git and working with code reviews
Software engineering principles such as SOLID and clean code
interview_focus: Core subjects: operating systems, databases and networks

ML Engineer.summary: ML engineers train, evaluate and ship models that learn from data.
employers_expect: Strong Python and data handling (NumPy and pandas)
Core ML algorithms and how to evaluate them honestly
Statistics: distributions, testing and sampling
SQL for getting data
Ability to put a model behind an API
interview_focus: ML concepts: overfitting, bias and variance, metrics
A deep dive into one ML project
How you would handle imbalanced or messy data
